exposure: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (CAH) due to CYP11B1 deficiency (late-identified and untreated)
outcome: Clinical manifestations (ambiguous genitalia, hypertension, low cortisol levels)
cohort: Five affected but untreated 46,XX family members with late-identified CAH due to CYP11B1 deficiency and ambiguous genitalia.
finding: Medical treatment and sex assignment decisions in late-identified 46,XX CAH patients in Indonesia are heavily influenced by local and cultural factors, leading to treatment refusal by some due to androgen dependency.
